'''Primitive Bolsters''', known internally as '''Bano e'Zetmo''', is a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
*Spawned by level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Bolster]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Primitive Bolsters are slow-moving support units with moderate melee capabilities.

*Primitive Bolsters deal damage on contact.
*If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Primitive Bolsters can perform the following ability:
**Giving Regeneration II (0:30) to nearby Parasites up to 16 blocks away, with a cooldown of 30 seconds.
*Primitive Bolsters are capable of extinguishing fire within melee range.
*Primitive Bolsters have a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifiyng it.
*Primitive Bolsters can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Primitive Bolsters can break blocks of a [[Hardness]] value up to 1, with a 60-tick cooldown and 1-block range.
*If a Primitive Bolster gets 10 kills, it will evolve into an [[Adapted Bolster]].
{{Variants|count=2|Virulent=VirulentPriBolster.png|Breacher=BreacherPriBolster.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Like all Parasites, Primitive Bolsters are weak to fire. Damage inflicted by fire and lava is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Primitive Bolsters have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Primitive Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|Call of the Hive]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Bolsters will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Bolsters are internally known as '''Bano''' and '''Zetmo''', seemingly interchangeably. Whether or not this is a mistake is unknown.
**'''Zetmo''' was the Bolster's name in early betas, which would match the naming convention used by other primitives.
**Sometimes these names are combined into '''Bano e'Zetmo''', such as in the Compendium.
*To "bolster" something means to support or strengthen it, which may reference the Bolster's tankiness and ability to give Regeneration to other parasites.
